verdict.rationale: Readable text was captured from the front pages of both unternehmensregister.de and handelsregister.de, including guidance prose on register access, the Bilanz-Navigator, publication orders and LEI. The llms.txt probe returned a plain HTTP 404 rather than a challenge page. Together these suggest the public reading surface is served as fetchable HTML, but no probe explicitly confirms keyless access with an identified user agent free of bot walls or CAPTCHAs, and the front page warns of overload-driven temporary unavailability. Missing for 10: an explicit hands-on probe showing HTTP 200 with a standard identified UA, confirmation that deeper guidance pages (not just front pages) carry no CAPTCHA, bot wall or JS-only shell, and an agent-oriented docs index (llms.txt is 404).
